verdict.rationale: The only booking-related evidence is 'Appointment booking pages' listed on the Google Workspace pricing page, which describes paid Workspace plans. Nothing in the pack documents a booking link on a free or individual account. The pricing axis clearly applies to a scheduling product, so the lack of free-tier evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As a founder, the free tier covers real individual scheduling — a usable booking link without a paid plan
